shortDescription: Manages resource-smtp objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: action_1
options.description: Use the Rewriting Rules to rewrite Sender and Recipient headers in emails, you can also rewrite other email headers by using the custom header field.

options.name: action_2
options.description: Use this window to configure mail inspection for the SMTP Resource.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: check_rulebase_with_new_destination
options.description: The Rule Base will be rechecked with the new resolved IP address for mail delivery.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: cvp
options.description: Configure CVP inspection on mail messages.

options.name: deliver_messages_using_dns_mx_records
options.displayName: Deliver Messages Using Dns Mx Records
options.description: MX record resolving is used to set the destination IP address of the connection.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: error_check_rulebase_with_new_destination
options.displayName: Error Check Rulebase With New Destination
options.description: The Rule Base will be rechecked with the new resolved IP address for error mail delivery.

options.name: error_deliver_messages_using_dns_mx_records
options.displayName: Error Deliver Messages Using Dns Mx Records
options.description: MX record resolving will be used to set the source IP address of the connection used to send the error message.

options.name: error_mail_delivery_server
options.description: Error mail delivery happens if the SMTP security server is unable to deliver the message within the abandon time, and Notify Sender on Error is checked.

options.name: exception_track
options.description: Determines if an action specified in the Action 2 and CVP categories taken as a result of a resource definition is logged.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: mail_delivery_server
options.description: Specify the server to which mail is forwarded.

options.name: match
options.description: Set the Match properties for the SMTP resource.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: notify_sender_on_error
options.description: Enable error mail delivery.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
